In 2013, a tugboat flipped off Nigeria's coast and sank almost 100 feet. Trapped inside was Harrison O'Kine, the ship's cook.
In total darkness, he found a small pocket of air above the rising water. 11 other crew members didn't survive. And the air around him was running out.
whole hours past, then another day. More than 60 hours after the sinking, rescue divers entered the wreck, expecting to find bodies.
One diver spotted a hand. He reached for it. And the hand moved. Harrison was alive.
He was carefully rescued and treated in a decompression chamber. In the unbelievable part, that moment was caught on camera.
